PL_BROWNFIELD_SITE_PROVIDERS
The brownfield-site dataset reported five providers.
PL_API_POINT_INTERSECTION
The Planning Data API supports latitude/longitude queries returning entities whose geometry intersects the point.
PL_API_MULTI_DATASET
A coordinate query can request multiple datasets in one call.
PL_API_GEOMETRY_ENTITY
The API supports geometry_entity to filter records using another entity's geometry.
PL_API_WITHIN_RELATION
The API supports geometry_relation=within for records contained by an entity geometry.
PL_API_BROWNFIELD_WITHIN_LPA
Brownfield land can be queried within a local-planning-authority boundary using geometry_entity.
PL_API_LIMIT_FIELD_SELECTION
API requests support limits and selected response fields.
EA_GPKG_REPLACES_SHP
LiDAR Composite and SurfZone DEM download indexes are no longer supplied as shapefiles.
EA_GPKG_OPEN_FORMAT
GeoPackage is described as an open geospatial format.
EA_GPKG_TRANSFER_SUPPORT
GeoPackage better supports transfer of downloadable geospatial data.
EA_GPKG_GRADUAL_DSP
GeoPackage implementation is being introduced gradually across the Data Services Platform.
EA_GPKG_IN_ZIP
LiDAR Composite and SurfZone DEM download ZIP files now contain a GeoPackage spatial metadata index.
EA_GPKG_SPATIAL_LOCATION
The GeoPackage index describes the spatial location of raster elevation data.
EA_GPKG_TEMPORAL_EXTENT
The GeoPackage index describes the temporal extent of raster elevation data.
EA_GPKG_SCHEMA_GUIDES
Technical guides describe the index-file format and attribute schema.
EA_POINT_DENSITY_RESOLUTION_DEPENDENT
Average LiDAR point density depends on the required surface-model resolution.
EA_POINT_DENSITY_1M
A 1 m DSM survey requires at least one point per square metre on average.
EA_POINT_DENSITY_50CM
A 50 cm DSM survey requires four points per square metre on average.
EA_POINT_DENSITY_25CM
A 25 cm DSM survey requires sixteen points per square metre on average.
EA_POINT_DENSITY_DSM_NOT_DTM
Published point-density figures relate to the DSM last/only returns, not necessarily the DTM.
EA_DTM_VEGETATION_DENSITY
Under vegetation, the DTM point density may be lower than the nominal DSM density.
EA_DENSITY_FLIGHT_OVERLAP
Point density can increase where multiple flight lines overlap.
EA_POINT_CLOUD_IRREGULAR
A LiDAR point cloud is not a regular grid.
EA_METADATA_ALL_PRODUCTS
Index catalogues can be downloaded for all LiDAR products.
EA_METADATA_COLLECTION_SEASON
The index catalogues include information on the time of year data was collected.
EA_ABSOLUTE_ERROR_15CM
The LiDAR specification requires absolute height RMSE below plus or minus 15 cm.
EA_RELATIVE_ERROR_5CM
Expected relative height error is no more than plus or minus 5 cm.
EA_GROUND_TRUTH_COMPARISON
Absolute height RMSE compares LiDAR elevations with a Ground Truth Survey.
EA_PROJECTION_OSGB36
Environment Agency LiDAR data is supplied in OSGB36 British National Grid.
EA_VERTICAL_DATUM_AODN
Elevations are recorded above Ordnance Datum Newlyn.
EA_COMPOSITE_OSTN15
The LiDAR Composite is transformed using the OSTN15 model.
EA_TIME_STAMP_GEOID_METADATA
Time-stamped and point-cloud metadata identifies the geoid model used for each survey.
EA_POST_20160826_OSGM15
Surveys after 26 August 2016 use the OSGM15 geoid model.
EA_AOI_INDEX
Survey Index Catalogues can be used to check data availability for an area of interest.
EA_AOI_NO_LISTING_NO_SURVEY
If an area is not listed in the survey index, the location has not been surveyed to date.
EA_DOWNLOAD_TILE_5KM
The open portal provides LiDAR downloads in 5 km by 5 km tiles.
EA_PORTAL_NO_LARGE_REQUEST
The portal cannot process large-area data requests.
EA_MULTI_TILE_SMALL_AREA
Several tiles can be downloaded together only for relatively small areas.
EA_NO_NATIONAL_BULK
The portal has no whole-country or large-area bulk-download option.
OS_GRID_ASCII_TEXT
OS Terrain 50 ASCII grid is a generic text-based DTM format.
OS_GRID_ARCINFO_NAMES
The format is also known as ArcInfo ASCII grid or ArcGrid ASCII.
OS_GRID_STANDARD_GIS_READ
Most standard GIS software can read ASCII grid without translation.
